podcast.body: This demo, informally known as "the green album," contained four songs including "Try Honesty," "Cut the Curtains," "This Is How It Goes," and "Beach Balls." It was recorded in Burlington at The Music Gym with Justin Cooper, and only 200 to 250 copies were made. This EP was significant as the band intentionally focused their sound, departing from the eclectic nature of "Wattouche," and is credited with saving the band. "There's one more demo that's, it's the green album and it's like a four song demo. And we only made like 200 or 250. ... And we literally just kind of focused our sound into one thing. And that was, that ended up being the four songs on the screen EP. And it was just called the Billy Talent EP."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
